nativeGeometry.coordinateSystem: unsized authored main-region root encloses fixed 1920x1080 wheel-layout child before UMG ScaleToFit/SafeZone; geometry is source-derived, not measured capture evidence

selector.angleConvention: degrees clockwise from screen-right; positive Y points down

drawing.ring: six broken 48-degree arcs with 12-degree gaps; 1.5-unit line
drawing.tileFrame: nine-point chamfered 56-unit frame; 1.5-unit normal or 3-unit selected line
drawing.glyph: token-specific native vector linework at tileHalf * 0.52 radius
drawing.queue: amber queued rim, cyan selected rim, red blocked glyph, all from authored custom color properties
drawing.content: authored content slot paints above native ring/tiles
drawing.focus: OnQueryShowFocus returns false to suppress the default widget-wide Slate focus rectangle; the selected tile frame remains highlighted.

glyphGeometry.throw: diamond fallback with horizontal impulse line

stateExpectations.opening: Hold opens wheel; cooldown advancement freezes while open and the host pauses only a previously unpaused world.
stateExpectations.hover: Blocked powers remain selectable to show actor, description and block reason.
stateExpectations.queue: One queued power per actor; a new power replaces that actor's slot. Unavailable, cooling and shield-blocked powers cannot queue.
stateExpectations.release: Revalidate all queued slots before command publication; success returns actor-ordered commands and starts shared actor cooldown, while failure closes and discards without commands/cooldown mutation.
stateExpectations.cooldown: A dispatched actor's powers share the selected duration as remaining time and denominator; authored base durations return on expiry and published fraction stays within [0,1].
stateExpectations.cancel: Cancel closes and clears queue without deployment.
stateExpectations.target: Shield toggle changes target copy, shield-strip visibility and shield-sensitive usability.
stateExpectations.sourceReload: Rejected authored source retains last committed view and queue.

verificationBoundary: Final remake scoped gate passed 34/34 with 35 fresh native captures across all four remakes; see ../ReplicaRemakes/verification-receipt.json. Original proof receipts remain historical.
styleSemantics: Each node computedStyle is the merged explicit declaration of its authored CSS class tokens, in source order. It excludes defaults and inherited properties; sizingPolicy identifies absent explicit dimensions.
